evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies invalid block handling and block index tree traversals in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Avoids duplicate logging and redundant block index tree traversals when handling invalid blocks in ActivateBestChain. While reviewing #31405 and #31533 revealed that SetBlockFailureFlags and RecalculateBestHeader were being run twice in immediate succession on failure paths, this is an internal cleanup and minor optimization of error handling rather than a fix for a consensus or stability vulnerability.
